sources.label: Official Cath Kidston Womens Clothing size guide (product-page guide on next.co.uk, where cathkidston.com now redirects)

notes: UK brand known for floral prints and vintage-inspired designs, now sold through Next: cathkidston.com redirects to next.co.uk/cath-kidston. UK sizing. Relaxed, comfortable cuts — slightly generous. Often found second-hand in excellent condition as items are treasured.
audit: cathkidston.com/pages/size-guide redirects to next.co.uk/cath-kidston (page titled Official Cath Kidston). Size Guide on Cath Kidston items is headed 'Cath Kidston Womens Clothing' (same on a hoodie and a skirt), CM tab; UK/EU/US and letter from its International Sizes table. Old 6 82/62/86 now 80/61/88; 12 94/74/98 now 95/76/103; 16 103/83/107 now 105/86/113. 18 added. Caveat: the chart is hosted on Next, Cath Kidston's seller since the redirect.
